data.name: Murabbiy
data.long_meaning: One who instructs, guides and helps others to learn and grow, a mentor or a teacher.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is a spiritual teacher and guide, helping others to find their path and grow in their faith.

in_arabic.name: مرّبي
in_arabic.meaning: من يعظّم ويربي الآخرين بالعلم والإيمان
in_arabic.long_meaning: مرّبي هو من يعظّم ويربي الآخرين بالعلم والإيمان، مشتق من الجذر الرباعي 'ر-ب-ب' الذي يعني التربية والتعليم. يوحي الاسم بالشخص الذي يلعب دورًا هامًا في تربية وتعليم الآخرين، سواء كان ذلك في المجال الديني أو العلمي. يشير إلى الشخص الذي يسعى لنشر المعرفة والإيمان بين الناس.

in_urdu.name: مرّبی
in_urdu.meaning: جو لوگوں کو علم اور ایمان کے ساتھ تیار کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرّبی وہ شخص ہے جو لوگوں کو علم اور ایمان کے ساتھ تیار کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ر-ب-ب' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے تربیت اور تعلیم دینا۔ یہ نام اس شخص کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے جو دوسروں کی تربیت اور تعلیم میں اہم کردار ادا کرتا ہے، خاص طور پر دینی اور علمی شعبوں میں۔

in_hindi.name: मुरब्बीय
in_hindi.meaning: जो लोगो को ज्ञान और विश्वास के साथ तैयार करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुरब्बीय वह व्यक्ति है जो लोगों को ज्ञान और विश्वास के साथ तैयार करता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'र-ب-ب' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रशिक्षण और शिक्षा देना। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति की ओर संकेत करता है जो दूसरों के प्रशिक्षण और शिक्षा में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, विशेष रूप से धार्मिक और वैज्ञानिक क्षेत्रों में।

in_pashto.name: مرّبی
in_pashto.meaning: چا کسانو ته د علم او ایمان په ګډون چمتو کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مرّبی هغه څوک دی چا کسانو ته د علم او ایمان په ګډون چمتو کوي. دا نوم د عربي ريښو 'ر-ب-ب' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د روزنې او زده کړې معنی لري. دا نوم هغه چا ته اشاره کوي چو په خاصه توګه ديني او علمي برخو کې د نورو د روزنې او زده کړې په برخه کې مهم رول لوبوي.

in_english.name: Murabbiy
in_english.meaning: One who educates and brings up others with knowledge and faith
in_english.long_meaning: Murabbiy is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ب-ب' (R-B-B), meaning to educate, bring up, or raise. In Islamic context, Murabbiy refers to a person who plays a significant role in educating and nurturing others, particularly in religious and scientific fields. The name implies a mentor or teacher who guides individuals on the path of knowledge and faith. Historically, the term has been used to describe scholars and educators who have contributed to the intellectual and spiritual growth of their communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Murabbiy holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community as it signifies the role of a mentor, teacher, or guide for others. This role is highly valued in Islamic tradition as it emphasizes the importance of knowledge transmission and community support. The title Murabbiy can be applied to various roles in society, from a formal teacher in a madrasa (religious school) to an informal guide and elder. Murabbiy plays an essential part in the education and intellectual development of younger generations, imparting knowledge and wisdom while also embodying Islamic virtues and values. The tradition of Murabbiy has contributed to the rich cultural heritage of Islamic civilization and continues to be a significant influence in modern Islamic communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Murabbiy also holds profound spiritual significance within Islam. It reflects the essential quality of being a guide to others on the path to spiritual growth and enlightenment. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) himself was a Murabbiy to his community, instructing and guiding them towards living a virtuous and righteous life in accordance with Islamic teachings. By following the example of the Prophet and striving to be a Murabbiy oneself, individuals contribute to the overall spiritual growth and development of their community and the larger Islamic nation. The role of a Murabbiy is not just confined to one's profession but is an essential aspect of being a good Muslim and a responsible member of society.
